rationale: Not a duplicate: the invoice carries a distinct service period (2026-02-15/2026-03-14) versus the prior paid invoice HL-3301 (2026-02-01/2026-02-28), so clause 8's fifth condition fails and clause 8.1 treats it as a legitimate recurring monthly charge (the billed name also normalises differently). Price matches the PO exactly (clause 3), recomputed 7.5% tax equals the supplier's $300.00 (clause 5), and this is a SERVICES PO so the absence of a goods receipt is not a defect (clause 1). No open credit memos; $4,300.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).
